correctness.rationale: The second-difference rows are independent, every active constraint subset has a strict KKT realization since D is surjective, and on its full-dimensional cell the Euclidean projector Jacobian equals H_A=I−B_Aᵀ(B_AB_Aᵀ)⁻¹B_A. Piecewise-linearity implies the global ℓ∞ two-input norm is max face absolute row sum. Independently enumerated all subsets with exact SymPy rational arithmetic: n=2 1, n=3 4/3, n=4 7/5, n=5 11/7 uniquely at active rows 1 and 3 and output center; n=6 91/57. The 5-site KKT witness is explicit. Block embedding proves monotonicity, and Green matrix inverse of tridiagonal diag 6/offdiag 1 for alternating active rows yields a limiting central row norm 1+1/√2; independently computed m=2,3,5,10,50 convergence to 1.7071067812. This is a constructive liminf, not a sharp unknown limit.
